name: Space Ghost Coast to Coast
description: A cartoon superhero interacts with live guests via his television set in this parody talk show based on 1960s Hanna-Barbera cartoon character Space Ghost.

videos.title: The Mask
videos.overview: Space Ghost defends the honor of Lassie against the director of The Mask, whilst Jim Carrey refuses to give advice to the universe.

videos.title: A Space Ghost Christmas
videos.overview: Space Ghost, Zorak, Moltar, and the Council of Doom unite for the festive season with altered variations of Christmas classics.

videos.title: Space Ghost Syndication Special
videos.overview: Space Ghost waits for a large cash payment from the "syndication weasels" so he can perform some all-new material.

videos.title: Dark Side of the Ghost Planet Planetarium Tour
E3 2006 - Dan Hsu
videos.overview: Space Ghost does a live interview with Dan Hsu of Electronic Gaming Monthly at the 2006 E3 Convention.

videos.title: E3 2006 - Daniel Sussman
videos.overview: Space Ghost does a live interview with Daniel Sussman of The Acrobrats, as well as a creator of Guitar Hero 2.

videos.title: E3 2006 - John Tam
videos.overview: Space Ghost does a live interview with John Tam of Red octane, creators of Guitar Hero.

videos.title: E3 2006 - Peter Moore
videos.overview: Space Ghost does a live interview with Peter Moore, then head of Microsoft's X-Box division.

videos.title: E3 2006 - Peter Molyneux
videos.overview: Space Ghost does a live interview with Peter Molyneux, generally considered the creator of the God game and creator of Populous, Dungeon Keeper, and the Fable series to name a few.

videos.title: E3 2006 - Todd Howard
videos.overview: Space Ghost does a live interview with Todd Howard of Bethesda where he led development on Fallout 3 and the Elder Scrolls games.

videos.title: Dinner with Steven
videos.overview: Unfinished bonus value episode.

videos.title: The Room Bumpers
videos.overview: Adult Swim produced bumpers for the April Fools 2010 showing of "The Room" in the style of a Space Ghost Coast to Coast episode.

videos.title: Spanish Translation
videos.overview: After declaring his fondness for Mexican food, Space Ghost asks diet guru Susan Powter what super powers help "stop the insanity." Comedian Kevin Meaney discusses the virtues of wearing tight pants and the Bee Gees stop by for a short, bizarre visit.

videos.title: Gilligan
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews the cast of Gilligan's Island and tries to find out if the show is real.

videos.title: Elevator
videos.overview: Self-proclaimed goddess of the galaxy Judy Tenuta and Space Ghost decide to visit the Elvis Chapel in Las Vegas. Space Ghost also talks with Dr. Timothy Leary, a man branded by Nixon as "the most dangerous man alive." Then, it's tacos for everybody, even actress Ashley Judd.

videos.title: CHiPs
videos.overview: As Space Ghost interviews his guests, Moltar introduces his fascination of the TV series "CHiPs" while he produces the show.

videos.title: Bobcat
videos.overview: Space Ghost's real identity Tad Ghostal is revealed by Zorak.

videos.title: Banjo
videos.overview: While Zorak is trying to use hypnotic powers on Space Ghost, the pet sea monkey Banjo is steadily growing out of control.

videos.title: Punch
videos.overview: Space Ghost finds himself making his interview with The Jerky Boys extremly awkward when he accidentally insults them and tries to change the subject by saying "Punch" multiple time to prove it loses all it's meaning when repeated.

videos.title: Batmantis
videos.overview: When Moltar is kidnapped by the mysterious Your Mother, Space Ghost reluctantly recruits the help of Zorak, who dresses up as the super "hero" Batmantis, to rescue him.

videos.title: Self Help
videos.overview: Dr. Joyce Brothers gives Space Ghost advice on how to improve himself...but eventually reveals that she believes Space Ghost has a split personality, Space Ghost sadly proves her right...

videos.title: Gum, Disease
videos.overview: Moltar is feeling sick, and his constant sneezing and throwing up do more damage than usual to the production of the show, Zorak wants some gum, and only Branford Marsalis can deliver it.

videos.title: President's Day Nightmare
videos.overview: The fate of one animation creator hangs in the balance as Space Ghost hosts a series of new cartoon shorts, only one of them, or the winner of a swimsuit competition, will emerge victorious

videos.title: Story Book House
videos.overview: Kirk the Storyteller and Carl the Cartoonist offer Space Ghost viewers, through Carl's drawings and Kirk's narration, "exciting" versions of classic Space Ghost: Coast 2 Coast adventures

videos.title: Girlie Show
videos.overview: As Space Ghost swoons over the thought of meeting Fran Drescher, whom he has a crush on, Zorak and Moltar plot a rebellion behind Space Ghost's back.

videos.title: Hungry
videos.overview: The Ghost Planet gang are hungry. They order a pizza but it gets delivered to the wrong address. Zorak's nephew Raymond is visiting the studio. Michael Stipe offers to take the guys to dinner, but Zorak eats Raymond instead.

videos.title: Fire Drill
videos.overview: Donny Osmond comes prepared for Space Ghost...so does a woolly Panda.

videos.title: Le Livre D'Histoire
videos.overview: Lokar reluctantly presents two clips from the Space Ghost archives to the audience, at the same time complaining about the show as a whole...

videos.title: Sleeper
videos.overview: Hulk Hogan asks Space Ghost who is the most powerful being in the Turner organization... and Slash is given a "warm reception" by the crew when they ditch him to drink coffee at the Cafeteria.

videos.title: Jerk
videos.overview: This episode starts with Brak yelling. There is a whole Zorak audience, and Space Ghost says, "The lone audience of The Apocalypse." Next, they take some calls on the show. Chad, Space Ghost's brother, calls. Then the IRS calls. Space Ghost yells for everyone to get out.

videos.title: Urges
videos.overview:
Zorak feels the urge to return to his home planet for "Mantis Mating Season", but is reluctant when he finds out he will die if he mates with a female. Michael Sweet persuades Zorak to make the attempt anyway.

Zorak later returns, having been saved by a male Mantis in drag who was part of a resistance movement against the Mantis mating ritual.

videos.title: Explode
videos.overview: While Space Ghost trades witty repartee (read: the usual insipid silliness) with Terry Jones, Lokar tries to lure Moltar away from the show and onto his own talk program with promises of lots of fancy fringe benefits.
Space Ghost is fed up with Moltar and Zorak, and decides to replace them with his super computer named Mo 2000.

videos.title: Lovesick
videos.overview: The show's energy takes a serious hit while Space Ghost deals with his emotions after being dumped.

videos.title: Transcript
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Jonathan Richman. That's it.

videos.title: Sharrock
videos.overview: The show takes a while to start, with the title music heavily extended, Thurston Moore joins the show as Ghost Planet comes under attack, forcing Space Ghost to bombard the audience with another extended musical number before finally revealing that the entire show was simply a dedication to the music of the late Sonny Sharrock.

videos.title: Boo!
videos.overview: Michael Norman isn't afraid of Space Ghost, and Bill Nye is afraid that he might never know what Space Ghost IS...

videos.title: Freak Show
videos.overview: Space Ghost's interview is interrupted by a pirate channel created by one of the show's more...dedicated fans (aka a geek who knows everything about the show and lives with his mother). Despite Moltar's efforts, the geek is determined to have his demands met before he will relinquish control.

videos.title: Switcheroo
videos.overview: While Space Ghost is called away on various pretenses, his evil twin brother Chad tries to take his place.

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: While Space Ghost is out, Zorak and Moltar recruit the Council of Doom to plan a surprise party for Space Ghost's birthday. But by the looks of it, the Council is hoping it'll be the unpleasant kind of surprise...

videos.title: Glen Campbell
videos.overview: Matt Groening, creator of The Simpsons, finally comes face to face with Space Ghost in a great interview as he salutes Space Ghost, asks him what he's a ghost of, and gives his opinion on Casper's resemblance to Richie Rich. Also, Moltar escapes...

videos.title: Jacksonville
videos.overview: Space Ghost is forced to deal with the annoying and easily frightened Tansit who has replaced Moltar as the show's director, when Space Ghost forces Tansit to reveal where Moltar is, he leaves his special guests Metallica to the mercy of Zorak.

videos.title: Late Show
videos.overview: Former Late Show with David Letterman writers scripted this unabashed spoof of late-night talk show convention.

videos.title: Cookout
videos.overview: This one starts out with arguments about Beefaroni, and Space Ghost elects the Council of Doom and Brak to judge a cooking contest. Zorak wants all of the bones for a soup, and they talk about cooking Space Ghost. One chef makes duck tacos, and another plays gymnastics with a dead chicken. Space Ghosts says it's a tie, and then blows up the Council of Doom, and finally Brak gets shot. He cries, and wants his lawyer.

videos.title: Art Show
videos.overview: Space Ghost assembles artists for a special on the power of portraits.

videos.title: Woody Allen's Fall Project
videos.overview: Re-enactments of classic moments from the last few series played by real actors, a strange episode.

videos.title: Rehearsal
videos.overview: A behind the scenes episode.

videos.title: Gallagher
videos.overview: Space Ghost introduces 'Space Time Quiz Fun 9000' and his 'contestants'. What follows is a rapid-fire conversation in more ways than one, as Odenkirk's growing addiction to power-band blasts results in a steady volley from Space Ghost.

videos.title: Edelweiss
videos.overview: Zorak is zapped until he can apparently no longer regenerate, leaving Space Ghost without a bandleader. Moltar is instructed to fill in for his dearly departed friend by singing renditions of German folk songs, which puts Beck, the show's lone guest, to sleep.

videos.title: Anniversary
videos.overview: Space Ghost marks a 'special notch in the belt that is the Space Ghost saga'.

videos.title: Zoltran
videos.overview: Space Ghost chats with Robin Leach until his guest reveals that he is, in fact, an evil villain named Zoltran.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Lokar hosts a fake pilot for the show Birdman Coast to Coast.

videos.title: Speck
videos.overview: Moltar and mechanic-turned-musician Jack Logan share a creepy conversation about items underneath their beds. Meanwhile, an irritating speck in Space Ghost's eye stops the show cold, a final calamity on a night of amusing mishaps.

videos.title: Zorak
videos.overview: An episode dedicated to Zorak. Includes an edited version of the episode "Zorak" from the original Space Ghost series.

videos.title: Switcheroo '97
videos.overview: Zorak and Moltar have a convention without inviting Space Ghost, prompting him to create Space Ghost Con '97.

videos.title: Mayonnaise
videos.overview: While attempting to introduce Jon Stewart to the wonders of aroma therapy, Moltar accidentally cuts off his oxygen.

videos.title: Brilliant Number One
videos.overview: Space Ghost pays homage to his real boss by continually referring to Peter Fonda as 'Ted Turner's brother-in-law.'

videos.title: Boo Boo Kitty
videos.overview: During Space Ghost's interview with McKean & Lander (or lack thereof), a menacing 'kitty' blimp hovers around Ghost Planet.

videos.title: Needledrop
videos.overview: Space Ghost decides to do the 'hip shake' throughout the show. Meanwhile, Zorak attempts to hypnotize all the guests.

videos.title: Sphinx
videos.overview: Mike Judge kindly asks Space Ghost to 'whack the Rugrats.' Space Ghost agrees to the job, as long as he can get onto one of Judge's shows.

videos.title: Pavement
videos.overview: Space Ghost repeatedly confuses Pavement with The Beatles and saves Jupiter from Fidor. The Great Gazoo has a cameo.

videos.title: Untitled
videos.overview: Space Ghost, an unofficial member of the P-Funk Mob, sets the groove in motion with George Clinton, but Moltar attempts to wrest the show from Space Ghost's control so he can interview his hero and the star of TV's 'CHiPs,' Erik Estrada.

videos.title: Hipster
videos.overview: Space Ghost's hip brother Chad takes over the show and makes fun of how Space Ghost is a square. Zorak and Moltar keep asking what happened to Space Ghost but Chad won't tell.

videos.title: Piledriver
videos.overview: Grandpa Space Ghost (voiced by Randy "Macho Man" Savage, RIP) stops by the show to visit his nephew, Tad Ghostal.

videos.title: Suckup
videos.overview: Desperate for a new gig, Space Ghost kisses up to Talk Soup host John Henson and Entertainment Tonight host Bob Goen by telling each that they are 'pretty men.'

videos.title: Dam
videos.overview: Space Ghost welcomes its first-ever Academy Award–winner, Charlton Heston, who after much prodding, offers his trophy to Space Ghost.

videos.title: Boat Show
videos.overview: Steve Allen and Andy Dick guest-star in this musical extravaganza! Brak is on the street. Space Ghost sings. Zorak sings. Andy has to dance.

videos.title: Brilliant Number Two
videos.overview: Space Ghost, once again, interviews Peter Fonda and the 'moonwalking' Buzz Aldrin. This is a sequel to "Brilliant Number One".

videos.title: Telethon
videos.overview: Space Ghost holds a telethon with the Council of Doom because he's out of money, but ends up losing even more money.

videos.title: Dimethylpyrimidinol Bisulfite
videos.overview: Space Ghost and Zorak try to endorse ointment and potted meat to the home viewing audience.

videos.title: Joshua
videos.overview: A parody of corporate videos with a brief appearance at the end of two winners of a haiku contest.

videos.title: Terminal
videos.overview: Space Ghost is terminally ill and will die when the show ends, but no-one seems to care. Perhaps they see through Space Ghost's 'illness'.

videos.title: Toast
videos.overview: Space Ghost wants to impress the love of his life (Merrill Markoe) but doesn't know how to act around 'women of the opposite sex.

videos.title: Lawsuit
videos.overview: Jace, Jan, and Blip from the original Space Ghost try to sue Space Ghost. Space Ghost gets out of it, and he blasts Blip. He also claims he destroyed Paris.

videos.title: Cahill
videos.overview: A vicious storm on Ghost Planet has Space Ghost scared silly.

videos.title: Warren
videos.overview: Space Ghost grows angry upon learning that he has been 'imposternated' on Warren's television program, so he goes with Moltar and Zorak to confront him. Warren is actually a very bitter bush.  We then meet an evil replica of Space Ghost, or is it Gary Owens...

videos.title: Chinatown
videos.overview: Space Ghost trades Moltar to a Japanese baseball team and makes a dog the new director.

videos.title: Rio Ghosto
videos.overview: Space Ghost pursues a movie career.

videos.title: Pal Joey
videos.overview: Annoying intern Joey wreaks havoc on the set while trying to get a job. Meanwhile, Space Ghost reveals to Michael Moore that he doesn't pay his employees.

videos.title: Curses
videos.overview: There is a showing of part of an old Space Ghost show. Space Ghost eats a bald guest. Emo is crazy, and Space Ghost eats him. There is a pretty woman, and Space Ghost demands more guests. Space Ghost says, "I'm never eating here again." He then eats Zorak and attacks Moltar.

videos.title: Intense Patriotism
videos.overview: Space Ghost, Zorak, and Moltar are moving to America. Space Ghost invites Jeff Foxworthy on the show and asks him about rednecks. Jeff obviously doesn't enjoy himself. Space Ghost hopes to become America Ghost as they find a place to land, in America.

videos.title: Waiting for Edward
videos.overview: Moltar beats the crap out of Space Ghost in a fist fight, and then jumps up and down on his back. Later, Zorak sits on Space Ghost's lap and demands $10 for "special services".

videos.title: Chambraigne
videos.overview: Space Ghost angers the creators of an intelligence enhancement drug when he begins to endorse it on his show.

videos.title: Snatch
videos.overview: Replicating Pods invade the Ghost Planet as The Blob blocks off all outside access.  Space Ghost, Zorak, and Moltar come up with many unsuccessful plans and resort to drinking lots of coffee.

videos.title: Girl Hair
videos.overview: Members of Hanson have long hair and Space Ghost is obsessed with combing it. Special appearances by the Tooth Fairy and Santa.

videos.title: Sequel
videos.overview: After Space Ghost has been sent to the slammer for years of mistreating Jan and Jace, Birdman is called upon to guest host the show, but spends most of his time lamenting an impending divorce from his wife Galaxy Girl, a.k.a. Sylvia.

videos.title: Curling Flower Space
videos.overview: Jerry Springer and Sarah Jessica Parker nearly get trampled in this bizarre romp through the minds of Space Ghost, Moltar and Zorak.

videos.title: Table Read
videos.overview: The show's voice actors and writers rehearse (in live-action) the episode Fire Ant.

videos.title: Fire Ant
videos.overview: Space Ghost and talk show host Conan O'Brien are engaged in riveting and witty repartee when a fire ant bites Space Ghost and everything goes Dada.

videos.title: King Dead
videos.overview: Zorak and Moltar leave Ghost Planet and break into Space Ghost's apartment. Brak and Tansut replace them on the show.

videos.title: Fire Ant (short version)
videos.overview: A much shorter version of Space Ghost's "interview" with Conan O'Brian and his encounter with the small Fire Ant.

videos.title: Snatch (alternate ending)
videos.overview: Ghost Planet Industries is attacked by replicating pods. The kind that copy your DNA, kill you off, and take over while you sleep.

videos.title: Kentucky Nightmare
videos.overview: Space Ghost is now promoting a liquor company. With the company mascot, everything is going crazy. Windows cracked, bears attacking, and killer bees.

videos.title: The Justice Hole
videos.overview: An agitated Space Ghost leaves his own show, but can't find anything to do.

videos.title: Knifin' Around
videos.overview: Space Ghost wants to burn 100 Radiohead cd's with some kind of laser cannon, right in front of Radiohead! Moltar sings, we meet Space Ghost's wife Bjork, and Zorak talks like a hillbilly.

videos.title: Flipmode
videos.overview: Space Ghost is hosting a "mystery dinner theater" and in the midst, he beats Zorak senseless a number of times and causes a massive gas leak, which causes everyone to start tripping, including guest Busta Rhymes.

videos.title: Sweet For Brak
videos.overview: Space Ghost becomes jealous when Brak's spin off, The Brak Show becomes a hit. Meanwhile, Zorak teaches the band Tenacious D how to perform.

videos.title: Mommentary
videos.overview: The writers of Space Ghost: Coast 2 Coast assemble their mothers together to commentate on "Kentucky Nightmare"

videos.title: Mommentary: Creator's Commentary
videos.overview: The S.G writers commentate on their mothers' commentary

videos.title: Mommentary: Jellybean
videos.overview: Special edition of "Mommentary" with new commentary from the shows producers.

videos.title: Baffler Meal
videos.overview: Space Ghost's talk show is invaded by three life-sized fast food items from a place called Burger Trench. They are known as the Aqua Teen Hunger Force. They soon proceed to throw the show into total chaos.

videos.title: Whipping Post
videos.overview: Space Ghost is angry about a variety of topics, and rants mightily to his guest, comedian Dennis Miller

videos.title: Eat a Peach
videos.overview: Space Ghost Explains The Birds And Bees To Zorak And Moltar.  As in Bees can't drive and crows can shoot lasers out of they're eyes.  Also, Moltar feels bad that Space Ghost seems to give Zorak more attention, as does Todd Barry when the crew decides not to share any crow with him.

videos.title: In Memory of Elizabeth Reed
videos.overview: In one of the most random episodes ever, Space Ghost's interview with William Shatner is cut short when he is called into action to take part in an epic space battle.

videos.title: Idlewild South
videos.overview: Zorak and Moltar are doing drugs and drinking booze when the show starts. Space Ghost wonders what they're doing, and Moltar encourages Space Ghost to drink some because it will "Make you feel like a Cowboy". After 1 sip he starts riding his TV, doing the Robot, and other crazy stuff, that eventually results in a series space ship related accident.

videos.title: Dreams
videos.overview: Space Ghost hosts a telethon to raise money for "Retardos" and enlists Triumph's help.

videos.title: Live at the Fillmore
videos.overview: Space Ghost ends up in jail, so once again Zorak and Moltar bail him out with the show's budget.

videos.title: Billy Mitchell
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Billy Mitchell, the first person to reach a perfect score in Pac-Man and Donkey Kong score record holder.

videos.title: Rand Miller
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Rand Miller, creator of Myst.

videos.title: Kenny Wayne Shepherd
videos.overview: Blues musician Kenny Wayne Shepherd is interviewed.

videos.title: Allan Alcorn
videos.overview: "Mr. pong", Allan Alcorn, is interviewed.

videos.title: Steve Wozniak
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Steve Wozniak, co-founder of Apple.

videos.title: Rob Fulop
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Rob Fulop, creator of several hit Atari 2600 titles such as Demon Attack.

videos.title: Howard Warshaw
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Howard Warshaw, designer of E.T on the Atari 2600, often called "the worst game ever made".

videos.title: Wayne Coyne
videos.overview: Wayne Coyne, lead singer of the Flaming Lips, is interviewed.

videos.title: Richard Garriott
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews "Lord British", other wise known as Richard Garriott, best known for creating Ultima.

videos.title: Stephen Bristow
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews Stephen Bristow, an early employee of Atari who conceptualized games like Breakout.

videos.title: David Crane
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews David Crane, a prolific game programmer who started work on the Atari 2600 and continued all the way up to the controversial Night Trap.

videos.title: Chantal Claret
videos.overview: Lead singer of the band Morningwood, Chantal Claret, is interviewed.

videos.title: Dee Snider
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews the lead singer of twisted Sister, Dee Snider.

videos.title: Barenaked Ladies
videos.overview: Space Ghost interviews the Barenaked Ladies.
